2024 STATE OF THE U.S. SEMICONDUCTOR INDUSTRY
U.S. TECHNOLOGY 
COMPETITIVENESS
U.S. semiconductor R&D expenditures are consistently 
high, reflecting the inherent link between U.S. market-share 
leadership, research investments, and continued innovation. 
In 2023, overall U.S. semiconductor industry investment in R&D totaled $59.3 billion. The growth 
in R&D spending in 2023 represented an increase of 0.9% over 2022. R&D expenditures by U.S. 
semiconductor firms tend to be consistently high, regardless of cycles in annual sales, which reflects 
the importance to our industry of investing in innovation.
